info.title: Hanzo Cloud API
info.description: Generated from the live router — every operation below is a route the unified cloud binary actually serves. Tagged by product: the first path segment after /v1/.

get.summary: listTools returns every tool resolvable in the caller's (org, project) — from
get.description:
listTools returns every tool resolvable in the caller's (org, project) — from
every source — each carrying whether it is activated, optionally narrowed to
one source and/or to the activated set.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Source keeps only tools from that source (builtin, mcp, connector, ...).

parameters.name: activated
parameters.description: Activated keeps only the tools activated for the caller's (org, project).

get.summary: getActivation returns the tool names activated for the caller's (org, project).
get.description: getActivation returns the tool names activated for the caller's (org, project).

put.summary:
putActivation applies a batch of toggles for the caller's (org, project) — the
ONE write path that turns skills, plugins and connectors on and off — and
returns the resulting activated set.
put.description:
putActivation applies a batch of toggles for the caller's (org, project) — the
ONE write path that turns skills, plugins and connectors on and off — and
returns the resulting activated set. At most 256 toggles per call.

get.summary: listServers returns the external MCP servers the caller's org has registered.
get.description:
listServers returns the external MCP servers the caller's org has registered.
The auth secret is never returned — only whether one is sealed.

post.summary: createServer registers an org's external MCP server.
post.description:
createServer registers an org's external MCP server. The auth secret VALUE is
sealed in KMS (per-org ref); SQLite keeps only the URL + header name + a
has-secret flag. The URL is SSRF-validated at the boundary; the dialer re-checks
at connect time (DNS-rebinding defense).

delete.summary:
deleteServer removes one of the caller org's external MCP servers and answers
204.
delete.description:
deleteServer removes one of the caller org's external MCP servers and answers
204. A server belonging to another org reads as not found.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID is the server id from the path, as returned by create.

enabled.description: Enabled is every activated tool name; empty, never null, when none are.

activate.description: Activate names the tools to switch on for the caller's (org, project).

deactivate.description: Deactivate names the tools to switch off.

authHeader.description: AuthHeader is the header name the secret is sent in.

name.description: Name identifies the server, required, at most 128 characters.

secret.description:
Secret is the auth secret VALUE. It is sealed in KMS and never stored in
SQLite nor returned by any read.

url.description: URL is the server endpoint; it is SSRF-validated here and again at connect.

authHeader.description: header to inject the KMS secret into (e.g. "Authorization").

recipient.description: payout wallet ref for the marketplace seller.

servers.description: Servers is every server the caller's org registered; empty, never null.

activated.description:
Activated is filled by the registry from the activation store for the
requesting (org,project); providers leave it zero.

tools.description: Tools is every tool matching the filter, from every source.
